# DeepDive — Smart School Management Platform

> DeepDive is a school management platform for Indian schools that unifies
> attendance, lecture recordings, AI-powered question answering, and
> real-time analytics in one secure, role-based system. Schools apply
> online and are typically live within a week.

## What the platform does

- **Attendance**: Teachers mark a full class register in under a minute.
  Date-range views, per-student statistics, leave and holiday management
  come built in.
- **Lecture recordings**: Classes are recorded and uploaded securely.
  Students can rewatch any lesson the same evening; every recording is
  searchable.
- **AI Q&A (Study Assistant)**: Students ask questions in plain language
  and get answers grounded in their own school's lecture recordings and
  course material, with references to the exact class. Includes practice
  questions, flashcards, notes, assignments, and lesson planning tools.
- **Analytics**: Administrators see attendance trends, enrollment,
  engagement, and survey feedback in real time on one dashboard.
- **Roles**: Administrators, teachers, students, and parents each get a
  tailored view. Parent accounts are linked to a student and approved by
  the school. Access is role-based and default-deny.

## Getting started

- Schools apply at https://ddai.work/onboarding/apply
  (about 10 minutes), verify by email OTP, and are reviewed within
  ~2 business days. Onboarding is guided and free.
- Application status: https://ddai.work/onboarding/status
